content:
anna: Heads-up — Support forwarded two tickets that look like the same feature ask (per-tenant rate limits for embeddings). Tickets `#5384` and `#5401`. AE also flagged this for a >$200k customer. Can product pick a canonical thread and owner?
triage-bot: Related tickets found: `#5384` (support), `#5401` (support), AE note `AE-293`. Similarity score 0.84. Suggested canonical: #5384.
mike: Thanks. Agree we should pick a canonical. quick Q: is this a legal/regulatory/data residency ask or pure throttling/cost control?
anna: Pure throttling/cost control — customer wants per-tenant quotas and clearer rate limit error codes. They hit throttling in spikes; not a data/TLS issue.
josie: Ok. Proposed plan:
- Canonicalize to `#5384`.
- Tag with `customer-ask`, `billing-impact`, `tenant-rate-limits`.
- Priority: P2 for platform work, but mark as P1 for the named customer (AE follow-up + interim mitigation).
- Owner: @josie (PM) to write scope + acceptance criteria.
- Engineering lead: @ben for feasibility + perf impact.
sarah: For backlog hygiene, we should close `#5401` as duplicate and leave a cross-link explaining canonical ticket and expected timeline. Also notify AE and both requesters with a short template.
mike: +1. Also flag for roadmap discussion next triage if engineering estimates >2w.
ben: Quick engineering note — per-tenant quotas are doable but need two pieces: quota enforcement (cheap) and quota UI/observability (more effort). If we ship enforcement only, we should call it "enforcement v1" and plan a follow-up for reporting. Perf risk: small at low QPS, but big if we do strict redis-backed counters for millions of tenants.
josie: Acceptance criteria draft: 
```
- API: support per-tenant limit config (defaults to org-level if unset)
- 429 semantics: return structured JSON with `rate_limit.reason` and `retry_after_seconds`
- Admin UI: show per-tenant limits and current usage (v1 can be rolling-window approximate)
- Tests: e2e showing enforcement and proper 429 payloads
- Rollout: staged canary with fallback to org-level limits
```
anna: Can you add estimated engineering effort (ben) and design sketch (josie) by EOD Friday? AE wants an ETA for the named customer.
ben: I can do a rough estimate: enforcement v1 ~ 4 dev-weeks (one engineer full-time), UI/reporting v1 another 3-4 dev-weeks. Might be able to parallelize.
mike: Noted. For prioritization: label `cust:high-rev` on canonical ticket so sales/CS can escalate. We should also add `roadmap-consider` if we think this should be in the next minor release.
sarah: Draft reply template to requesters (short):
```
Thanks — we've consolidated your asks under ticket #5384.
Owner: Josie (Product).
Next steps: scope + ETA by <date>. Interim: we can enable org-level rate caps and monitor spikes — let us know if you want that enabled sooner.
```
josie: Will send that out after I post the scope. Also will add `duplicate_of:#5384` into #5401 and post the template.
anna: Who's ok to notify AE + both support contacts and offer interim org-level caps? @ben can we toggle that quickly?
ben: Yes, we can toggle org-level caps today for accounts that ask. No code deploy needed, just config change and a short DBA/ops check.
mike: Action items summarized:
- josie: write scope + acceptance criteria (by EOD Fri)
- ben: engineering rough estimate + toggle plan (tomorrow)
- anna: coordinate AE + support notification once scope is posted
- sarah: update `#5401` with duplicate closure and link to `#5384`
- triage-bot: add tags `customer-ask`, `billing-impact`, `cust:high-rev` to `#5384`

josie: Got it. I'll comment on #5384 now and ping here when done.
anna: Thanks — appreciate the quick sync. :thumbsup:
triage-bot: Tags added to #5384: `customer-ask`, `billing-impact`, `cust:high-rev`. Duplicate closed: #5401 -> closed (duplicate_of:#5384).
